answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one pigment weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, anyone who spins up 30 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 288 times the capital for one share. The orchard report reveals the merge explicitly at each reef. A farm of 3979 identities would post 1870 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
